title: Task × time-step Mirror normalization View
amendment: 05: corrected generic bank split and fresh-run seed amendment after premature command was interrupted
scope: Synthetic event-stream screen using a custom PyTorch hard-spike/triangular-surrogate LIF; not a TEBN paper reproduction or hardware energy result.
hypothesis: A shared low-rank task×time normalization code can preserve full TEBN quality with less actual serialized inference state when task/time gain matrices have low rank; generic full-rank task signatures should reveal the boundary. Any rank-r Mirror advantage over the identical native rank-r factorization is zero by construction.
physical_object: Fixed shared 8-channel-to-2-cell encoder, shared batch normalization, and two LIF neurons over 16 event bins.
mirror_coordinate: G[q,t] = U[q,:] V[:,t], with task code U and shared temporal bases V; rank-4 primary condition.
logical_multiplicity: Eight task-specific temporal event classifiers over shared synapses; task IDs are supplied to all task-conditioned methods and charged in payload metadata.
controls: one shared native TEBN time gain vector
full independent native task×time TEBN gain table
identical native rank-4 temporal factorization alias control

task_families.structured_rank3: K[q,t] = 0.35 + 0.65*cos(2*pi*(q/8 - t/16)); signed, bounded by 1 and rank at most 3.
task_families.generic_random: Fresh independent K[q,t] sampled uniformly from [-1,1], then normalized by max absolute value.
task_families.generic_random_status: Completed on corrected fresh worlds; train/test share one K bank per world. Full native TEBN achieved 100% mean accuracy.

data: For balanced y∈{-1,+1}, four positive event replicas have rate .5+.4*y*K[q,t] and four negative replicas rate .5-.4*y*K[q,t].

development.purpose: Confirm full task×time TEBN reaches >=90% and validate training/runtime only; no fresh selection.

fresh.generic_random_status: Completed with fresh seeds [96241,96243,96247] after retired interrupted seeds [96231,96233,96237] were excluded.

training.encoder: fixed W=[+1/4 x4,-1/4 x4] and its negative
training.lif: u=0.9*u+g[q,t]*BN(Wx); hard spike at 1 with triangular surrogate gradient; subtractive reset
training.batch_norm: shared running-statistics BN over batch×time; affine scale/shift fixed (not task/time-dependent)

storage.authority: actual custom serialized inference payload bytes
storage.format: one flattened typed tensor stream plus JSON manifest; same serializer for all conditions
storage.ordinary_alias_verification: Rank-4 Mirror and native factor state tensors are asserted equal after identical training seeds and batches.

compute: first-correct-spike latency with no-correct-spike censored at 16
success_gate: For each fresh world and task family, full TEBN reaches >=90% accuracy; rank-4 Mirror is within 2 percentage points of full on each task, serialized payload is <=80% of full, and spike count/latency regressions are <=10%.
failure_gate: Quality, actual-byte, or dynamic-operation gate miss. Native full below 90% means that family is NOT ESTABLISHED, not a Mirror FAIL.
boundaries: No natural event data, TEBN benchmark reproduction, GPU, joules, or hardware efficiency claim.
Rank-4 Mirror and ordinary rank-4 factorization use identical mathematics; no Mirror-specific gain can be claimed if they match.
Report structured and random banks separately; task combinations do not imply independent capacity.
The compact serializer is the declared inference format and all metadata/state are paid.
development_amendments: Amendment 01 had learnable BN affine values; native full table failed development at chance with zero spikes, while rank-4 factors learned the structured bank.
Development inspection showed shared BN beta became strongly negative. Amendment 02 freezes the shared BN affine values to isolate task/time normalization gain; fresh seeds remain sealed.

Amendment 03 freezes fresh evaluation to structured_rank3 after generic_random native full table failed the development feasibility gate at both 1,000 and 5,000 updates. The random bank is reported NOT ESTABLISHED, not FAIL.

Post-run audit found make_data derived K from each sample seed, so generic_random training and test used different task definitions. Existing generic_random development evidence is preserved in source/development_invalid_split.json and withdrawn. Structured_rank3 is unaffected because K is seed-independent. Amendment 04 passes a common bank_seed to train and test.

Corrected generic_random development uses a shared bank_seed across train/test; full TEBN reached 99.98%. A fresh run was started before the JSON protocol update succeeded and interrupted during its first condition; no row output was retained or used. Those seeds [96231,96233,96237] are retired. Amendment 05 freezes new fresh seeds [96241,96243,96247].
